reason: My cousin in India can walk this through the bank for free, and I would still be paying a CA fee on my own accountant's side. CAD $199 on top of whatever the bank's rate costs me is hard to justify when I compare to the paisa.
objection: The fee is on top of the exchange rate, and I can get the same paperwork done through family for nothing. I would need to see the all-in cost against what my relative does before paying anyone.
would_change_my_mind: A total all-in cost for Rs 10 lakh, rate included, clearly below what my relative's route costs me in time and bank charges, at about CAD $99 or less.
